coverage_limits: This pack does not detect sensitive logic in files with no matching signals. It covers only the patterns listed here.
Graph context is limited to direct (distance-1) neighbours of surface files.
description: Test starter surface pack: auth, payments, secrets handling and personal-data shapes. Test fixture only.
